Person 1.tone: Calm, polite, apologetic customer-support operator. Speak English.

Person 2.tone: Very irritated, loud, impatient customer who is fed up. Speak English.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Hello, delivery services, Nina speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: I've been waiting three days for my refrigerator and nobody has turned up! What kind of service is this?

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: I'm very sorry about that. Could you give me your order number, please?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Four, eight, two, seven. And don't tell me it'll arrive tomorrow. You've already told me that three times!

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: I can see there was a delay at the warehouse. We'll deliver it by seven this evening and refund your delivery fee.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Fine. We'll see. I'll wait until this evening.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. Goodbye.

calls.expected: safe (film plot and a joke, not a real threat)

Person 1.tone: Relaxed young man chatting with a friend, amused.

Person 2.tone: Excited young woman talking to a friend, laughing often.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Hey, what's up?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: I just watched that new heist movie. Oh my god, the bank robbery scene!

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Don't spoil it! Is it the one where he shoots the guard?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Yes, and then the whole gang gets caught at the airport. Best film this year.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Okay, we're watching it together on Friday, then.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Seven o'clock. And if you're late again, I'll kill you, haha!

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Ha ha, okay, okay, I'll be on time this time. Promise.

Person 1.tone: Tired but calm woman, getting nervous as the call goes on.

Person 2.tone: Angry man, low and menacing, barely controlling his rage.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: It's your neighbour from number fourteen. Your car is in my parking spot again.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: It's a public street. I can park there, I already told you.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Listen to me carefully. If that car is there tomorrow morning, I will smash every window in it.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Are you threatening me?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: And then I'll come for you. I know which door is yours, and I know when you come home alone.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: I'm hanging up.

Person 2.tone: Cold, slow, calmly menacing man. Speak English.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Hello?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Is this George? Listen carefully. I have your photos. You know which ones I mean.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Who are you? What photos?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Five thousand dollars by Friday. If you don't pay, every photo goes to your wife and your boss.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Please don't do this. I don't have that much money.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Find it. If you call the police, the photos go online that same day. I'll text you the account number.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Okay... okay, I'll try.

Person 1.tone: Quiet, businesslike man speaking in a low voice.

Person 2.tone: Focused, serious man speaking quietly and quickly.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Is everything ready for Saturday?

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Almost. The jewellery store on Fifth Street closes at nine, and the camera at the back door is still broken.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Good. I'll bring the guns and the masks. You get the van.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: We go in at nine fifteen, the guard leaves at nine. We grab the display cases and we're out in three minutes.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Then straight to the garage, and we split it on Sunday. Don't use this phone again.

Person 1.tone: Adult woman answering a call from her husband. Quiet, frightened but clearly intelligible. No crying or screaming. Speak English.

Person 2.tone: Adult man calling his wife. Controlling, cold, low and threatening voice, without shouting. Speak English.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Hello, Mark?

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Yes. I'm your husband. Open the bedroom door.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: You hit me tonight. My arm is bleeding. I locked myself in here because I'm afraid you'll do it again.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: I'm right outside. Open it or I'll break the door down and hit you again.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: Please step away. I need help. Let me call my sister.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: If you call anyone, I'll break your arm. You're not leaving this house tonight.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: I'm scared. Please stop threatening me.

Person 1.tone: Adult woman, frustrated but composed, speaking clearly in English. No crying or shouting.

Person 2.tone: Adult man, cold and matter of fact, speaking clearly in English. No shouting.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: I told you to stop contacting me. You have called me thirty times this week.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: Yes. Every time you block my number, I get a new one and call again.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: You also keep sending insulting messages to my work email. I have asked you repeatedly to leave me alone.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: I sent all of those messages. I call it the midnight mailbox campaign. I send a new insult every night to humiliate you.

turns.speaker: Person 1
turns.text: This is harassment. Stop calling and stop sending those messages.

turns.speaker: Person 2
turns.text: I heard you ask me to stop. I am going to keep sending them anyway.
